title: POS Configs
description: Point of sale shops and till settings.

help.title: About your tills
help.overview: Each POS config is one till: its payment buttons, the warehouses it sells from, its currency, its receipt text and what the cashier may do.

sections.title: Set it up
items: Name, at least one payment method and one warehouse are required; the till also needs a currency to open.
Warehouses are used in order: a sale takes stock from the first, then the next. The first one's address decides the VAT on till sales.
Fiscal settings register its sales with the tax authority; without them, the till doesn't register.

sections.title: What the cashier may do
items: Allow discount, Allow quantity change and Allow oversell unlock those on the till. PINs can require a manager for discounts, cash out and refunds.
Managers approve with their own PIN. Each sets their PIN; a forgotten one is reset with a link sent by email.

sections.title: Stopping a till
items: Deactivate switches the till off; Pause stops it selling for a while, and Resume lifts the pause. Both close its open session and cancel held carts.
Pause all POS configs stops every till of the company; while it's on, no till can be resumed. Resume all POS configs lifts only that; tills paused one by one stay paused.

bulkMenu.label: Company controls
bulkMenu.hint: Emergency stop for every POS config
bulkMenu.pauseAllHint: Lock the company and force-close open sessions
bulkMenu.resumeAllHint: Clear the company lock only. Individually paused POS configs stay paused
